option_relations.rationale: The option describes the same genetic condition as the leaf, HTRA1-related autosomal dominant cerebral small vessel disease, which is equivalent to heterozygous HTRA1-related cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD).
Hypertensive Small Vessel Disease is a different etiology for small vessel disease than the genetic HTRA1-related condition described in the leaf.
The option 'Hereditary Cerebral Small Vessel Disease (HTRA1-related)' is equivalent to 'Heterozygous HTRA1-related cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD)' as both refer to the same genetic condition.
The option 'Heterozygous HTRA1-related cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD)' is identical to the provided leaf ID.
